name: AgGrid
description: AgGrid Enterprise widgets with integrated charts: a table, a server-side table, an infinite table, a streaming grid and a SQL editor, each fed by its widget's endpoint.

licenseKey.title: AgGrid license key
licenseKey.description: AgGrid Enterprise license key for every card of the organization. Leave it empty to run AgGrid Community.

theme.title: AgGrid theme
theme.description: The AgGrid theme of every card of the organization, in the site's light or dark colours: balham (compact type), quartz, alpine, material, or compact (small type, short rows, no column lines, shaded rows).

accentColor.title: Accent colour
accentColor.description: The colour of selections, focus and links, such as #2563eb. Empty follows the site.

headerBackgroundColor.title: Header colour
headerBackgroundColor.description: The background of the column headers, such as #f3f4f6. Empty follows the theme.

fontFamily.title: Font
fontFamily.description: The font of every grid, such as Inter, sans-serif. Empty follows the site.

cspNotes.script-src: Compiles DuckDB-WASM, the package's own assets/duckdb-eh.wasm, which completes the SQL editor's queries inside the frame.
cspNotes.connect-src: DuckDB-WASM reads its binary from a blob: URL the frame makes of that asset. No host is reachable.

widgets.name: AgGrid table
widgets.description: A backend's rows in AgGrid with OpenBQ's table configuration, row groups, pivot, calculated columns, charts, and grid events sent back to the endpoint.

response.description: Rows as JSON: records, a dict of columns, pandas split, or { columnDefs, rowData, gridOptions }; or { transaction: { add, update, remove } }. data["aggrid-table"] takes OpenBQ's table configuration.

definition.description: OpenBQ's table configuration (data.table there), and the grid events sent to the backend.

gridEvents.description: The grid events that send the grid state to the endpoint, in the gridState body param, so the backend can answer them. None by default.

enableCellExpressions.description: Cell values that start with = are expressions over the row, such as =[quantity] * [price]. Evaluated by the plugin, never as code.

columnState.description: The grid layout a new card opens with: parts of an AG Grid grid state, directly or under `default`. A card's own saved layout replaces it.

filterModel.description: The filters a new card opens with, as an AG Grid filter model keyed by column.

emptyValue.description: The text of an empty cell, such as - or n/a. Empty by default.

enableFormulas.description: The Formulas panel of the side bar, where a user adds columns computed from the others, such as [Revenue] / [Shares]. On unless false.

fill.description: A hex colour or a CSS colour name.

stroke.description: A hex colour or a CSS colour name.

customFormatter.description: An arrow function in a string, (params) => ({ fill, stroke, ... }). Evaluated without eval: literals, params.*, operators, ?: and Math functions.

xKey.description: For points that are objects: the key of the x value.

yKey.description: For points that are objects: the key of the y value.

stroke.description: A hex colour or a CSS colour name.

label.description: Bar sparklines: the value on each bar.

color.description: A hex colour or a CSS colour name.

url.description: openUrl: the link, with {field} placeholders. Without it, the cell's value is the link.

renderFn.description: One of greenRed, titleCase, hoverCard, cellOnClick, columnColor, showCellChange, or a list of them.

calculatedExpression.description: The column's value as an expression over the row's columns, such as [revenue] - [cost]: literals, [column], + - * / %, comparisons, && || ??, ?: and Math functions.

rowGroup.description: Groups the rows by this column when the card opens.

rowGroupIndex.description: The column's place among the row groups.

pivot.description: Pivots on this column when the card opens (with pivot mode on).

aggFunc.description: The aggregation of this column in group and pivot rows.

xLabel.description: The title of the category or time axis.

yLabel.description: The title of the number axis.

dateLabels.description: Dates on the category axis as dates, as quarters (Q3 2024) or as fiscal years (FY 2024).

gridPreset.description: Parts of an AG Grid grid state (api.getState()): the layout a new card opens with.

filterCondition.description: One AG Grid column filter model: text, number, date, set or multi.

columnFilter.description: One AG Grid column filter model: text, number, date, set or multi.

licenseKey.title: AgGrid license key
licenseKey.description: AgGrid Enterprise license key for this card. It replaces the organization's key.

theme.title: AgGrid theme
theme.description: The AgGrid theme of this card; it replaces the backend's and the organization's, in the site's light or dark colours: balham (compact type), quartz, alpine, material, or compact (small type, short rows, no column lines, shaded rows).

floatingFilters.title: Floating filters
floatingFilters.description: A filter box under each column header.

advancedFilter.title: Advanced filter
advancedFilter.description: One filter over all the columns, typed as an expression or made in the filter builder. It replaces the column filters and the Filters tool panel while it is on.

decimals.title: Decimal places
decimals.description: Decimal places of numbers without their own, 0 to 8. Empty follows the site.

abbreviateNumbers.title: Abbreviate large numbers
abbreviateNumbers.description: Numbers of a million or more as M, B or T, such as 45.00B. The tooltip shows the full number.

statusBar.title: Status bar
statusBar.description: Row counts and the sum, average, minimum and maximum of the selected cells. On unless turned off.

pagination.title: Pages
pagination.description: auto pages above 100 rows unless the backend says otherwise; on and off decide for this card.

pageSize.title: Rows per page
pageSize.description: auto fits the rows to the card.

filterBar.title: Active filters bar
filterBar.description: The filters that are on, above the grid, each with a button that removes it. On unless turned off.

chartNavigator.title: Chart navigator
chartNavigator.description: A range selector under cartesian charts. Unset follows the widget's chartView.

chartMiniChart.title: Chart navigator with mini chart
chartMiniChart.description: The navigator draws a small copy of the chart. Unset follows the widget's chartView.

chartDistinctColors.title: One colour per bar
chartDistinctColors.description: Bar and column charts of one series give each category its own colour.

artifact.description: Rows in AgGrid: sortable, filterable, groupable, pivotable and exportable. For records or query results. With chartView { enabled: true, chartType }, it opens as a chart: the column with chartDataType category along the axis, the series columns as values.

wsRowIdColumn.description: The row id field, which server-side transactions from data.streamEndpoint need.

widgets.name: AgGrid infinite table
widgets.description: AgGrid's infinite row model: rows load in blocks as the user scrolls, each block's startRow and endRow, sort and filter written to the widget's own params.

response.description: One block of rows: a list of records, or an object with rows under rowData, rows, items, results, records, value or data and an optional total. A short block ends the table.

definition.description: How the widget asks its endpoint for a block of rows and reads the answer, and OpenBQ's column configuration.

enableCellExpressions.description: Cell values that start with = are expressions over the row, such as =[quantity] * [price]. Evaluated by the plugin, never as code.

blockSize.description: The rows each request asks for.

requestParams.description: The widgets.json param that carries each part of the request, when its name is not the part's own, such as offset: $skip and limit: $top.

rowsKey.description: A dot path to the rows in the answer, when they are not rowData, rows, items, results, records, value or data.

totalKey.description: A dot path to the total row count, when it is not rowCount, lastRow, total, totalCount, count, totalRecords or @odata.count.
